questions: Is difficulty with balance or walking the main reason you are being evaluated?
Do you have weakness on one side of your body?
Do you have numbness or tingling on one side?
Have you had trouble speaking, understanding speech, or seeing clearly?
Have you experienced severe dizziness or a spinning sensation?
Have you fainted or nearly fainted?
Have you fallen recently because of this problem?
Do you feel unsteady even when standing still?
Do you have a tremor in your hands or legs?
Do you have stiffness or slowness of movement?
Do you have a headache that is new or unusually severe?
Have you recently had a head injury?
Have you previously had a stroke or transient ischemic attack?
Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
Are you taking any medications that could affect your balance or alertness?
Have you consumed alcohol or recreational drugs recently?
Do you have pain in either hip, knee, ankle, or foot that affects your walking?
